global_style: An elegant, editorial-style presentation featuring minimalist layouts, oversized serif typography, earthy muted tones, and distinctive geometric edge notches.

identity_anchors: Oversized vertical display text bleeding off the left edge
Semi-circular notch cutouts on image and shape boundaries
High-contrast editorial typography pairing a dominant Serif with a clean Sans-serif
Abundant negative space emphasizing asymmetric content placement

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
